subject: Is it possible to combine colour and size scales in legend?

messages.author: 1e82ea932416652e
messages.subject: Is it possible to combine colour and size scales in legend?
parts:
I have a data set with which I am creating a dot plot, and would like to map one of the variables to both colour and size (this seems to help interpretation and comprehension better than mapping the variable only to colour or only to size). ggplot2 insists on creating separate legends for size and scale; I'd like to combine them, as can be done in ggvis with add_legend(scales = c("size","fill")). Is this possible?

Minimal eproducible example:

# libraries used
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggvis)

# example data, ordered for plotting in ggplot2 
some_data <- data.frame(x = factor(letters[1:10]), 
                        y = runif(10), 
                        c = seq(from = 0.4, to = 1.0, length.out = 10))
levels_order <- some_data[order(some_data$y, decreasing = TRUE),]$x
some_data$x <- factor(some_data$x, levels = levels_order)

# the ggplot2 version, note separate legends 
ggplot(some_data, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = c, size = c)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 5)) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "brown", high = "green4") +
  coord_flip()

 # the ggvis version, note colour and size are combined in the legend
some_data %>% 
  ggvis(~x, ~y, fill = ~c, size = ~c) %>% 
  layer_points() %>% 
  add_legend(scales = c("size","fill"), title = "Earth similarity index")
  
Alternatively, I might settle for the ggvis version if I could control the color, as I can with scale_colour_gradient() in ggplot2.

Thank you,

Tom

messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to combine colour and size scales in legend?
parts:
You just need to tell ggplot2 to use a standard legend instead of a
continuous colour bar:

ggplot(some_data, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = c, size = c)) +
geom_point() +
scale_size(range = c(2, 5)) +
